name: High Orchard
description: HIGH ORCHARD. The First Rides finale, raced as a trials day in eight numbered sections (boards S1-S8): from the cider farm, through the orchard and up the dirt mountain, then through a tunnel into the next world, The Woods, where the crowd waits at the finish. A race: every apple and the flower lie ahead, nothing sends you back. Medium, about 45 s for a good rider. APPLES in the order you meet them. S1 rollers past the beehive: gas and lean. S2 a deep dip and a big hill: momentum carries you up, then a small kicker hops you through apple 1 onto a downslope. S3 the hollow: the lip throws you through apple 2 floating over it. S4 the braking descent: apple 3 hides at the foot of a drop and is only caught rolling off slowly; full gas flies over it. S5 the tall hill: carry speed up the face and the crest throws you through apple 4. Halfway flag. S6 the islands: a kicker throws you onto island A (apple 5), its lip up onto island B, and B's lip drops you onto lower island C (apple 6). S7 the climb: five slopes, each taller and steeper, then the dirt crag to apple 7 at the lookout. S8 the tunnel: a lantern-lit cut through the mountain with a step-down and a roller, out into the light over the Woods. FINISH: down into the pines, through the arena and up a steep bank to the flower on the plateau. RECOVERY: a miss costs time, never the run. Fly over the braking apple and ride back to the drop's foot. Fall off an island into the meadow hollow and ride back west over the kicker. A stall on any slope rolls back to the terrace below; a stall on the last bank rolls back into the arena. SKILLS: rollers, momentum, hops, braking, big air, floating islands, steep climbs, climbing for height. ENDS: the cider farm (barn and apple shed) and the outcrop leaning over the finish plateau.
lesson: The First Rides finale, raced as a trials event in eight sections: rollers, momentum, a hop, a braking drop, big air off a tall hill, floating islands, the climb to the crag and a tunnel into The Woods.
alsoNew: A whole harvest trials day from the cider farm to a finish arena in the next world, reached through a tunnel under the mountain.
